gazetteer.description: Place-centric PLATO serialisation of the DEEP MADS XML (Jisc, 2017 release; mirrored 2026-09-26), county volume Cheshire. Generated and schema-validated against PLATO v0.4.0 (release 0.4.0, commit ca0afadabec1e23a145c0b03df77e8f151f79832). Identifiers are https://w3id.org/whg-epns/<county>/<serial>, carrying DEEP's own 2013 numbering (registration by the World Historical Gazetteer, pending merge at generation time). This serialisation is an adaptation and carries the same terms. plato_commit=ca0afadabec1e23a145c0b03df77e8f151f79832
